name: qualification-week
title: Qualification review
subtitle: Historical scores and current record checks. Run prioritise for a fresh handover list.

sections.title: Latest score records
sections.sql: select name,company,fit,engagement,total,segment,suppressed,outcome,as_of from latest_scores order by total desc

sections.title: Current attention
sections.note: The accuracy warning here uses the demo 90-day review policy; compliance uses the active model policy.
sections.sql: select name,company,owner,reason from qualification_attention order by name,reason

sections.title: Observed outcomes
sections.note: Descriptive counts, not a causal measure of model performance.
sections.sql: select * from qualification_outcomes order by segment,outcome

sections.title: Source exports
sections.sql: select * from source_freshness order by source
